meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你把消息渠道(如 Telegram、Slack)接到 agent 群组上:查询当前接线状态、设置隔离级别与线程策略、新增渠道群组,并列出特权用户。
howto.when: 在给某个平台添加渠道之后、做初始设置时,或你单独要求重新配置接线时触发;若实例还没有 owner,它会先让你运行 /init-first-agent。

say.text: 看看我现在的渠道接线情况
say.note: 会列出已接线、未接线和未配置的渠道

say.text: 把这个 Telegram 群接到我的 agent
say.note: 会先问隔离方式,再注册接线

say.text: 把这个渠道改接到另一个 agent 群组
say.note: 旧会话留在原群组,新消息走新群组

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude wires messaging channels (e.g. Telegram, Slack) to agent groups: it inspects current wirings, sets isolation levels and thread policy, adds new channel groups, and lists privileged users.
howto.when_en: Triggers after adding a channel, during setup, or when you ask to reconfigure wiring. If the instance has no owner yet, it first points you to /init-first-agent.

say_en.text: Show me my current channel wiring
say_en.note: Lists wired, unwired and unconfigured channels

say_en.text: Wire this Telegram group to my agent
say_en.note: Asks the isolation question, then registers

say_en.text: Move this channel to another agent group
say_en.note: Old sessions stay; new messages route to the new group
